```{python}
#| label: setup
import base64, io
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyBboxPatch, Polygon
from IPython.display import display, HTML, Markdown
from scipy.signal import correlate2d

BLUE, ORANGE, GREEN, GREY, RED, INK = "#1f4fd8", "#E8833A", "#1a7f37", "#888888", "#b5302a", "#222222"
plt.rcParams.update({"mathtext.fontset": "cm", "font.size": 13})


def md(s):
    display(Markdown(s))


def n(x, d=3):
    s = f"{x:.{d}f}"
    s = s.rstrip("0").rstrip(".") if "." in s else s
    return "0" if s in ("-0", "") else s


def png_uri(fig):
    b = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(b, format="png", dpi=150, facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)
    return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode()


def show_fig(fig):
    display(HTML(f'<img src="{png_uri(fig)}">'))


def stack(figs):
    """Figures on top of each other; each click shows the next one."""
    imgs = [f'<img src="{png_uri(figs[0])}">']
    imgs += [f'<img class="fragment" data-fragment-index="{i}" src="{png_uri(f)}">' for i, f in enumerate(figs[1:], 1)]
    display(HTML('<div class="r-stack">' + "".join(imgs) + "</div>"))


def table(header, rows):
    s = "| " + " | ".join(header) + " |\n|" + ":---:|" * len(header) + "\n"
    s += "\n".join("| " + " | ".join(str(x) for x in r) + " |" for r in rows)
    md(s)


def conv(x, w, b=0):
    """Slide the filter and take inner products (no flip, as deep learning libraries do)."""
    return b + correlate2d(np.asarray(x, float), np.asarray(w, float), mode="valid")


def relu(z):
    return np.maximum(0, z)


def pool(a, s=2):
    h, w = a.shape[0] // s, a.shape[1] // s
    return a[:h * s, :w * s].reshape(h, s, w, s).max(axis=(1, 3))


def out_size(n_, f, p=0, s=1):
    return (n_ - f + 2 * p) // s + 1


def conv_params(f, c_in, k):
    return (f * f * c_in + 1) * k


def fc_params(m, k):
    return (m + 1) * k


def canvas(size, xlim, ylim):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=size)
    ax.set_xlim(*xlim)
    ax.set_ylim(*ylim)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")
    fig.subplots_adjust(0, 0, 1, 1)
    return fig, ax


def cells(ax, A, x=0, y=0, cmap=None, vmin=None, vmax=None, fs=15, text=True, face="white", title=None, tfs=14, blank=None, fmt=None):
    """Draw matrix A with its top-left corner at (x, y). Cells where blank is True are left empty."""
    A = np.asarray(A, float)
    cm = plt.get_cmap(cmap) if cmap else None
    vmin = A.min() if vmin is None else vmin
    vmax = A.max() if vmax is None else vmax
    for r in range(A.shape[0]):
        for k in range(A.shape[1]):
            fc, tc = face, INK
            empty = blank is not None and blank[r, k]
            if cm and not empty:
                t = 0.5 if vmax == vmin else (A[r, k] - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
                fc = cm(t)
                tc = "white" if 0.299 * fc[0] + 0.587 * fc[1] + 0.114 * fc[2] < 0.55 else INK
            ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x + k, y - r - 1), 1, 1, fc="white" if empty else fc, ec="#999999", lw=1, zorder=2))
            if text and not empty:
                ax.text(x + k + 0.5, y - r - 0.5, fmt(A[r, k]) if fmt else n(A[r, k]), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs, color=tc, zorder=3)
    if title:
        ax.text(x + A.shape[1] / 2, y + 0.35, title, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=tfs, fontweight="bold", color="#444444", linespacing=1.3)


def frame(ax, x, y, h, w, color=ORANGE, lw=4):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, y - h), w, h, fc="none", ec=color, lw=lw, zorder=5))


def arrow(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, color="#777777", lw=1.8):
    ax.annotate("", xy=(x1, y1), xytext=(x0, y0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=color, lw=lw, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0), zorder=4)


def label(ax, x, y, s, fs=15, color=INK, **kw):
    ax.text(x, y, s, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs, color=color, **kw)


def color_grid(ax, A, x, y, title=None, tfs=14):
    """Draw an 8 x 8 x 3 image (values 0-9) as colored cells with its top-left corner at (x, y)."""
    for r in range(A.shape[0]):
        for k in range(A.shape[1]):
            ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x + k, y - r - 1), 1, 1, fc=A[r, k] / 9, ec="#999999", lw=0.8, zorder=2))
    if title:
        ax.text(x + A.shape[1] / 2, y + 0.35, title, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=tfs, fontweight="bold", color="#444444")


def img_axes(ax, A, title, cmap="gray", vmin=None, vmax=None):
    ax.imshow(A, cmap=cmap, vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=15)
    ax.axis("off")

BCOLS = [plt.get_cmap("tab10")(k) for k in range(9)]
```

```{python}
#| label: by-hand-helpers
from matplotlib.patches import Circle

EAPPROX = {0: 1.00, 1: 2.72, 2: 7.39, 3: 20.09}      # values of e^z given to students
BLOCKS4 = [(0, 0), (0, 2), (2, 0), (2, 2)]
BNAMES = ["top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right"]
CLS, CLS_COL = ["A", "B"], [ORANGE, BLUE]
CHN = [("R", "Reds", RED), ("G", "Greens", GREEN), ("B", "Blues", BLUE)]


def mm(s):
    """Use a real minus sign."""
    return str(s).replace("-", "−")


def make_problem(X, K, bias, W):
    X = np.asarray(X); K = np.asarray(K)
    if X.ndim == 2:
        X, K = X[:, :, None], K[:, :, None]
    parts = [conv(X[:, :, ch], K[:, :, ch]) for ch in range(X.shape[2])]
    Z = sum(parts) + bias
    A = relu(Z); P = pool(A); a = P.ravel()
    W = np.asarray(W, float); s = W @ a
    assert np.allclose(s, np.round(s)) and all(int(round(v)) in EAPPROX for v in s)
    return dict(X=X, K=K, bias=bias, parts=parts, Z=Z, A=A, P=P, a=a, W=W, s=np.round(s).astype(int), C=X.shape[2])


def blank_upto(shape, k_done):
    b = np.ones(shape, bool)
    for k in range(k_done):
        b[k // shape[1], k % shape[1]] = False
    return b


def pair_text(K2, w2):
    pairs = [(int(K2[r, c]), int(w2[r, c])) for r in range(2) for c in range(2)]
    prods = " + ".join(f"({k})×({v})" for k, v in pairs)
    vals = " + ".join(str(k * v) for k, v in pairs).replace("+ -", "− ")
    return mm(prods), mm(vals), sum(k * v for k, v in pairs)


def conv_fig(pr, i, j):
    """One window of the convolution, with the full multiplication written out."""
    X, K, Z, C = pr["X"], pr["K"], pr["Z"], pr["C"]
    mq = np.abs(Z).max()
    if C == 1:
        fig, ax = canvas((15, 5.0), (-0.5, 27.5), (-7.6, 1.4))
        cells(ax, X[:, :, 0], 0, 0, cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=4, fs=16, title="Image (5 × 5)")
        frame(ax, j, -i, 2, 2)
        w = X[i:i + 2, j:j + 2, 0]
        cells(ax, w, 7.0, -1.5, cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=4, fs=16, title="window", tfs=13)
        label(ax, 9.7, -2.5, "×", fs=22)
        cells(ax, K[:, :, 0], 10.4, -1.5, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-2, vmax=2, fs=16, title="filter", tfs=13)
        cells(ax, Z, 15.5, 0, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-mq, vmax=mq, fs=16, title="Feature map (4 × 4)", blank=blank_upto((4, 4), i * 4 + j + 1))
        frame(ax, 15.5 + j, -i, 1, 1)
        arrow(ax, 13.0, -2.5, 15.2, -2.5)
        prods, vals, _ = pair_text(K[:, :, 0], w)
        label(ax, 13.5, -5.6, f"window (row {i + 1}, col {j + 1}):   {prods}", fs=18, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
        label(ax, 13.5, -6.8, f"=  {vals}  =  {mm(n(Z[i, j]))}", fs=18, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
        return fig
    fig, ax = canvas((15, 6.2), (-0.5, 34.0), (-12.4, 1.4))
    for ch, (nm, cmap, col) in enumerate(CHN):
        x0 = ch * 9.4
        cells(ax, X[:, :, ch], x0, 0, cmap=cmap, vmin=0, vmax=4, fs=15, title=f"Image, {nm}")
        frame(ax, x0 + j, -i, 2, 2)
        label(ax, x0 + 5.55, -2.5, "×", fs=18)
        cells(ax, K[:, :, ch], x0 + 6.1, -1.5, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-2, vmax=2, fs=15, title=f"filter, {nm}", tfs=12)
        if ch < 2:
            label(ax, x0 + 8.75, -2.5, "+", fs=24, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    cells(ax, Z, 29.4, 0, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-mq, vmax=mq, fs=15, title="Feature map", blank=blank_upto((4, 4), i * 4 + j + 1))
    frame(ax, 29.4 + j, -i, 1, 1)
    arrow(ax, 27.5, -2.5, 29.1, -2.5)
    label(ax, 28.3, -1.8, "+ bias", fs=13, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    label(ax, 31.4, -5.0, f"bias = {mm(pr['bias'])}", fs=15, color="#444444", fontweight="bold")
    label(ax, 14.5, -6.6, f"window (row {i + 1}, col {j + 1}): filter × window, layer by layer", fs=16, color="#444444", fontweight="bold")
    subs = []
    for ch, (nm, cmap, col) in enumerate(CHN):
        prods, vals, tot = pair_text(K[:, :, ch], X[i:i + 2, j:j + 2, ch])
        subs.append(tot)
        ax.text(0.5, -7.9 - ch * 1.25, f"{nm}:   {prods}  =  {vals}  =  {mm(tot)}", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=17, color=col, fontweight="bold")
    total = " + ".join(f"({mm(v)})" if v < 0 else str(v) for v in subs)
    ax.text(0.5, -11.8, f"z  =  R + G + B + bias  =  {total} + ({mm(pr['bias'])})  =  {mm(n(Z[i, j]))}",
            ha="left", va="center", fontsize=18, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    return fig


def relu_fig(pr, i, j):
    Z, A = pr["Z"], pr["A"]
    mq = np.abs(Z).max()
    fig, ax = canvas((15, 4.4), (-0.5, 25.5), (-6.4, 1.4))
    cells(ax, Z, 0, 0, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-mq, vmax=mq, fs=16, title="Feature map")
    frame(ax, j, -i, 1, 1)
    cells(ax, A, 9, 0, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-mq, vmax=mq, fs=16, title="After ReLU", blank=blank_upto((4, 4), i * 4 + j + 1))
    frame(ax, 9 + j, -i, 1, 1)
    arrow(ax, 4.4, -2, 8.6, -2, color=ORANGE, lw=2.5)
    z = Z[i, j]
    label(ax, 19.2, -2.0, f"max(0, {mm(n(z))}) = {n(A[i, j])}", fs=20, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    label(ax, 19.2, -3.1, "negative numbers turn to 0" if z < 0 else ("positive numbers stay the same" if z > 0 else "0 stays 0"), fs=16, color=GREY)
    return fig


def pool_fig(pr, step):
    A, P, a = pr["A"], pr["P"], pr["a"]
    top = max(A.max(), 1)
    fig, ax = canvas((15, 4.4), (-0.5, 27.5), (-6.4, 1.4))
    cells(ax, A, 0, 0, cmap="Oranges", vmin=0, vmax=top, fs=16, title="After ReLU")
    for k, ((r, c), col) in enumerate(zip(BLOCKS4, BCOLS)):
        if k <= step:
            frame(ax, c, -r, 2, 2, color=col, lw=3.5)
            frame(ax, 7 + c // 2, -1 - r // 2, 1, 1, color=col, lw=3.5)
    cells(ax, P, 7, -1, cmap="Oranges", vmin=0, vmax=top, fs=16, title="Pooled", blank=blank_upto((2, 2), min(step + 1, 4)))
    arrow(ax, 4.4, -2, 6.6, -2, color=ORANGE, lw=2.5)
    if step < 4:
        r, c = BLOCKS4[step]
        v = A[r:r + 2, c:c + 2].ravel()
        label(ax, 19.5, -2.0, f"{BNAMES[step]} block:\nmax({', '.join(n(x) for x in v)}) = {n(v.max())}", fs=19, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    else:
        arrow(ax, 9.4, -2, 12.6, -2, color=ORANGE, lw=2.5)
        label(ax, 11.0, -1.4, "flatten", fs=14, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
        cells(ax, a[None, :], 13, -1.5, cmap="Oranges", vmin=0, vmax=top, fs=16, title="a")
        for k in range(4):
            label(ax, 13.5 + k, -3.0, f"$a_{k + 1}$", fs=15, color="#555")
        label(ax, 22.5, -2.0, "read row by row:\ntop-left, top-right,\nbottom-left, bottom-right", fs=14, color=GREY)
    return fig


def node(ax, x, y, text, fc="white", ec="#666666", fs=15, r=0.75, tc=INK, lw=2):
    ax.add_patch(Circle((x, y), r, fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=4))
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fs, color=tc, zorder=5)


def dense_fig(pr, step):
    """step 0: the network; 1: compute z_A; 2: compute z_B; 3: softmax."""
    a, W, s = pr["a"], pr["W"], pr["s"]
    IN_Y, OUT_Y = [3.6, 1.2, -1.2, -3.6], [2.0, -2.0]
    ez = [EAPPROX[int(v)] for v in s]
    tot = sum(ez)
    pr_ = [e / tot for e in ez]
    win = int(np.argmax(s)); los = 1 - win
    fig, ax = canvas((15, 6.0), (-2.6, 31.5), (-5.0, 5.4))
    for k, y in enumerate(IN_Y):
        for c, yo in enumerate(OUT_Y):
            wgt = W[c, k]
            if wgt == 0:
                ax.plot([0.75, 8.25], [y, yo], color="#cccccc", lw=1.2, ls="--", zorder=1)
                continue
            col = CLS_COL[c] if step in (c + 1, 3) else "#888888"
            ax.plot([0.75, 8.25], [y, yo], color=col, lw=3.2 if step == c + 1 else 2.0, zorder=2)
            t = 0.27 if c == 0 else 0.68          # class A labels near the inputs, class B labels near z_B
            tx, ty = 0.75 + t * 7.5, y + t * (yo - y)
            txt = n(wgt) if step != c + 1 else f"{n(wgt)} × {n(a[k])} = {n(wgt * a[k])}"
            ax.text(tx, ty, txt, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13 if step != c + 1 else 14,
                    color=col, fontweight="bold", zorder=6, bbox=dict(fc="white", ec="none", pad=1.5))
    for k, y in enumerate(IN_Y):
        node(ax, 0, y, f"$a_{k + 1}$\n{n(a[k])}", fc="#FDE3C8", ec=ORANGE, fs=14)
    label(ax, 0, 5.0, "inputs a", fs=14, color="#444444", fontweight="bold")
    label(ax, 9.0, 5.0, "dense layer (scores)", fs=14, color="#444444", fontweight="bold")
    for c, yo in enumerate(OUT_Y):
        node(ax, 9.0, yo, f"$z_{CLS[c]}$\n{s[c]}" if step > c else f"$z_{CLS[c]}$", fc="#dcf3e2",
             ec=CLS_COL[c] if step == c + 1 else GREEN, fs=14, lw=3 if step == c + 1 else 2)
    if step == 0:
        label(ax, 17.6, 0, "each line from $a_k$ to a class\ncarries one weight;\nthe score is\nsum of (weight × input) + bias", fs=15, color="#444444")
    if step in (1, 2):
        c = step - 1
        terms = " + ".join(f"{n(W[c, k])}({n(a[k])})" for k in range(4))
        label(ax, 17.6, OUT_Y[c], f"$z_{CLS[c]}$ = {terms}\n= {s[c]}", fs=15, color=CLS_COL[c], fontweight="bold")
        label(ax, 17.6, -4.4, "dashed edges have weight 0: they add nothing", fs=13, color=GREY)
    if step == 3:
        label(ax, 16.2, 5.0, "softmax", fs=14, color="#444444", fontweight="bold")
        for c, yo in enumerate(OUT_Y):
            arrow(ax, 9.9, yo, 14.0, yo, color=GREEN, lw=2.2)
            label(ax, 12.0, yo + 0.5, f"$e^{{{s[c]}}}$ ≈ {ez[c]:.2f}", fs=13, color="#444444")
            node(ax, 15.2, yo, f"$p_{CLS[c]}$\n{pr_[c]:.2f}", fc=CLS_COL[c] if c == win else "#eeeeee", ec="#999999", fs=14, r=0.9,
                 tc="white" if c == win else INK)
        W_, L_ = CLS[win], CLS[los]
        sw, sl = s[win], s[los]
        calc = [rf"$p_A = \dfrac{{e^{{z_A}}}}{{e^{{z_A}} + e^{{z_B}}}} = \dfrac{{e^{s[0]}}}{{e^{s[0]} + e^{s[1]}}} = \dfrac{{{ez[0]:.2f}}}{{{ez[0]:.2f} + {ez[1]:.2f}}} = \dfrac{{{ez[0]:.2f}}}{{{tot:.2f}}} \approx {pr_[0]:.2f}$",
                rf"$p_B = \dfrac{{e^{s[1]}}}{{e^{s[0]} + e^{s[1]}}} = \dfrac{{{ez[1]:.2f}}}{{{tot:.2f}}} \approx {pr_[1]:.2f}$",
                rf"2 classes: $p_{W_} = \dfrac{{1}}{{1 + e^{{-(z_{W_} - z_{L_})}}}} = \dfrac{{1}}{{1 + e^{{-({sw} - {sl})}}}} = \dfrac{{1}}{{1 + {1 / EAPPROX[sw - sl]:.2f}}} \approx {pr_[win]:.2f}$"]
        for k, (t_, y_) in enumerate(zip(calc, [3.0, 0.6, -1.8])):
            ax.text(17.3, y_, t_, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=15, color=INK if k < 2 else "#555555")
        ax.text(17.3, -3.9, f"predict class {W_} (larger score, larger probability)", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=15,
                color=CLS_COL[win], fontweight="bold")
    return fig


# Problem 1: a 5 x 5 grayscale image
PR1 = make_problem([[1, 0, 3, 3, 0], [0, 1, 3, 2, 0], [0, 0, 2, 3, 1], [1, 0, 3, 3, 0], [0, 0, 1, 2, 0]],
                   [[-1, 1], [-1, 1]], 0, [[0.2, 0, 0.2, 0], [0, 1, 0, 1]])

assert list(PR1["s"]) == [2, 1]
```

```{python}
#| label: two-blanks
MISS = [(0, 0), (0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3)]   # the first row of the feature map: ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4 (0-based here)


def gap_mask(k_done):
    """True where the feature map is still blank: the missing values not computed yet."""
    m = np.zeros((4, 4), bool)
    for q, (i, j) in enumerate(MISS):
        if q >= k_done:
            m[i, j] = True
    return m


def gap_fig(pr, k):
    """k = 0: the given feature map with its first row blank; k = 1..4: compute blank k."""
    X, K, Z = pr["X"], pr["K"], pr["Z"]
    mq = np.abs(Z).max()
    fig, ax = canvas((15, 5.0), (-0.5, 27.5), (-7.6, 1.4))
    cells(ax, X[:, :, 0], 0, 0, cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=4, fs=16, title="Image (5 × 5)")
    cells(ax, K[:, :, 0], 10.4, -1.5, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-2, vmax=2, fs=16, title="filter", tfs=13)
    cells(ax, Z, 15.5, 0, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-mq, vmax=mq, fs=16, title="Feature map (4 × 4)", blank=gap_mask(k))
    for q, (i, j) in enumerate(MISS):
        if q >= k:
            label(ax, 15.5 + j + 0.5, -i - 0.5, f"?$_{q + 1}$", fs=17, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    if k == 0:
        for q, (i, j) in enumerate(MISS):
            frame(ax, 15.5 + j, -i, 1, 1)
        label(ax, 13.5, -5.6, "Rows 2–4 are given. Compute the first row: ?$_1$, ?$_2$, ?$_3$, ?$_4$.", fs=17, color="#444444", fontweight="bold")
        label(ax, 13.5, -6.8, "Entry (row i, col j) uses the 2 × 2 window whose top-left corner is pixel (row i, col j).", fs=16, color=GREY)
        return fig
    i, j = MISS[k - 1]
    frame(ax, j, -i, 2, 2)
    w = X[i:i + 2, j:j + 2, 0]
    cells(ax, w, 7.0, -1.5, cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=4, fs=16, title="window", tfs=13)
    label(ax, 9.7, -2.5, "×", fs=22)
    frame(ax, 15.5 + j, -i, 1, 1)
    arrow(ax, 13.0, -2.5, 15.2, -2.5)
    prods, vals, _ = pair_text(K[:, :, 0], w)
    label(ax, 13.5, -5.6, f"?$_{k}$: window (rows {i + 1}–{i + 2}, cols {j + 1}–{j + 2}):   {prods}", fs=18, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    label(ax, 13.5, -6.8, f"=  {vals}  =  {mm(n(Z[i, j]))}", fs=18, color=ORANGE, fontweight="bold")
    return fig


assert [int(PR1["Z"][i, j]) for i, j in MISS] == [0, 5, -1, -5]
```
